main_issue: How Agent D can cook and eat before dawn during Ramadan without waking the other flatmates in the thin-walled flat

A-B.evidence: Both want quieter mornings. B says 'That's helpful for Mondays' to A's cook-ahead idea (turn 4), and both thank D for the same arrangement (turns 6, 9).

A-C.evidence: A proposed cooking the night before. C later asked for the same for Wed/Fri (turns 13-15), so they back the same arrangement without addressing each other.

A-D.evidence: A opened with a complaint (turn 1) and D replied with Ramadan (turn 2). A then proposed cooking ahead (turn 3), D agreed (turn 5) and A thanked D (turn 6).

B-C.evidence: B asked for quiet on Tue/Thu (turn 4). C asked for Wed/Fri (turn 13). Both are covered by D's cook-ahead plan and neither speaks to the other.

B-D.evidence: B gave exam days (turn 4). D agreed to cook the night before for Tuesday and Thursday (turn 5) and B thanked D (turn 9).

C-D.evidence: C said the noise would still wake them on Wed/Fri (turn 13). D offered to cook ahead for those days (turn 14) and C accepted with thanks (turn 15).
